newsitem.title: USA: Roberts says it responds to FDA.
newsitem.headline: Roberts says it responds to FDA.

text.p: Roberts Pharmaceutical Corp said Wednesay it has responded to a U.S. Food and Drug Administration citation issued November 18 that alleged certain deficiencies following a routine inspection of the company's Eatontown facility, and it expects the agency will soon indicate that its reply was satisfactory.
The company said that all appropriate tests were done on certain batches of Topicycline, that the tested lots complied with specifications, and that no product recall was requested by the agency.
The company added that it has written procedures concerning quality control, that those procedures are being formalized, and that additional quality assurance personnel are being hired.
Roberts focuses on the acquisition and development of specialty pharmaceuticals.
